body.zh: 新华、gov.cn、日喀则简报与@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus无新吉隆伤亡帖。中方仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。NDRRMA最新帖仍为9月26日#25，无更新SitRep。堰塞湖已排空。中方口岸关闭。Rising Nepal 10月2日：Syabrubesi–Rasuwagadhi周二下午轻车重开，夜间不建议。美使馆9月3日通告未更新。勿与中方相加。
body.en: No new Gyirong casualty post from Xinhua, gov.cn, Shigatse, @XHNews or @CCTV_Plus. CN remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. Latest NDRRMA post is 26 Sep #25; no newer SitRep. Lake drained. CN gate closed. Rising Nepal 2 Oct: Syabrubesi–Rasuwagadhi reopened Tuesday afternoon for light vehicles; no night travel. US Embassy 3 Sep notice not updated. Do not add CN.
body.ne: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus naya casualty chaina. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. NDRRMA antim #25 (26 Sep). Tal khali. CN gate band. Rising Nepal 2 Oct: Syabrubesi–Rasuwagadhi halka sawari; rat yatra nahos. US Embassy 3 Sep naya chaina. CN najodnu.
